styleObservations: 轮廓：短而清楚的暖棕描边，独立剪影在小尺寸可读。
形状：五角星略圆，纸页轻微弯曲，不改变原拉姆身体与四种颜色。
色面：星星金黄/橙影，纸页奶白/浅黄，细节仅保留两条阅读线。
高光：少量短高光，不为角色添加纹理或写实光照。
空间：星星在头顶扁椭圆轨道运行；独立右页从书脊向左翻，使用原书本与原角色图集。

assets.prompt: Draw ONE isolated small five-point golden yellow cartoon star, a readable game status accessory for an early Chinese Flash pet game. References show style only: warm dark ochre outline, slightly rounded asymmetric five points, lemon-yellow front face, exactly one flat orange shadow and one small pale highlight. Flat 2D hand-drawn game icon, no face, no sparkles around it, no words, no scene, no glow, no realistic material. Center the complete star with about 15 percent truly transparent padding on every edge. Will be displayed as a 10px star orbiting above a pet head, so use a very simple strong silhouette.
assets.editing: No post-generation pixel edits; copied original PNG. Runtime CSS positions and hinges the props.

assets.prompt: Create a separate animation accessory for the open golden storybook shown in reference image 1, matching the simple Chinese Flash pet-game style in reference 2. Draw ONE loose ivory paper leaf, seen from the same gently elevated front view, shaped like the RIGHT-HAND page of the reference book: straight-ish vertical binding edge on the left, gently curved top and bottom edges, slightly rounded corners, thin warm ochre outline, large cream flat fill, one pale yellow edge shadow, just two short light tan horizontal reading strokes. The page is lying almost flat, not folded or rolled. NO book cover, NO spine clasp, NO whole book, NO hands, NO objects behind it, NO glow. One complete isolated right-hand paper page centered on true transparent background, transparent padding 15 percent. This will be hinged on the left edge and rotated in 3D by the application for a real right-to-left page turn; do not draw motion trails or additional copies.
assets.editing: No post-generation pixel edits; copied original PNG. Runtime CSS positions and hinges the props.
